title: Signed-out visitors can spend members' daily Vera budget

source.ref: Mega pass 2026-11-19 (unknown-unknowns audit: abuse and cost blowups)

detail: Mega pass 2026-11-19. Vera's live loop accepts a signed-out caller (keyed by IP for the per-actor window), but every turn was accounted on 'vera-chat', the same $5/day feature cap members use. Anyone rotating IPs could exhaust it, and every member then got the deterministic fallback for the rest of the day. Fix: a turn with no profile is admitted against and accounted on its own key, 'vera-chat-anon', capped at $1/day in FEATURE_DAILY_CAP_USD; member turns are unchanged. Both runToolLoop calls keep a literal accounting feature, so the accounting inventory test still reads them. lib/ai/vera/agent-claude-anon.test.ts drives the real turn with the model stubbed.

verify.note: Fails on main (an anonymous turn is accounted on 'vera-chat'). Passes when it is admitted and accounted on 'vera-chat-anon' with a smaller cap, and members are untouched.
